entities.title: Browse current discovery surfaces
entities.definition: A user enters Home, date, weekend, popular, unusual, collection, festival, exhibition or club surfaces, scans a bounded current set and opens an event for evaluation.

confidence.basis: Production routes, analytics and acceptance inventory.

unresolved_conflicts: Not every route family has the same production, browser and outcome evidence.

entities.title: Enter a useful discovery surface
entities.definition: Open a current public route from direct navigation, search engine, social post, saved link or internal navigation.

confidence.basis: Route registry and page-view contract.

entities.title: Choose time, theme or editorial context
entities.definition: Use route, date, weekend, city, collection, popularity, unusual, festival or club context to narrow the current catalog without requiring a dynamic query.

confidence.basis: Listing, collection and route contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Some contexts are candidate or prototype surfaces rather than fully promoted production families.

entities.title: Scan exposed event cards
entities.definition: Review actually visible unique cards in the presented order until a promising event is found or the user changes context.

confidence.basis: Cards-to-first-value and exposure denominator contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Unified production card-exposure collection is not yet fully implemented.

entities.title: Open a promising event
entities.definition: Activate the canonical event-card open target and reach the matching current event detail without duplicate navigation or broken identity.

confidence.basis: Search health and event-card acceptance scenarios.

unresolved_conflicts: Accepted Search health proves this on the pinned Search target; full route-family health remains broader.

entities.title: Search from an explicit intent
entities.definition: An eligible user expresses an intent, receives structural progress, exact bounded results or an honest no-result state, opens a result and may answer whether the search matched.

confidence.basis: Current Search contract and accepted production health.

unresolved_conflicts: Health evidence does not prove satisfaction across the full intent distribution.

supersession_history.to: source-proven journey with accepted runtime health

entities.title: Open Search and resolve eligibility
entities.definition: Open `/poisk/`, preserve the static shell and either restore an accepted session or show an honest identity gate.

confidence.basis: Search and auth contracts.

entities.title: Submit one explicit intent
entities.definition: Enter a possibly multiline intent and submit through Enter/search action with one idempotent physical Search request.

confidence.basis: Original owner brief, current contract and health evidence.

entities.title: See structural progress without false cards
entities.definition: The Search surface keeps the accepted large-card skeleton and monotonic progress until exact cards or a terminal state are available.

confidence.basis: USR-14 and current Search UI contract.

unresolved_conflicts: Cross-browser visual parity of every progress state remains a UI SoT concern.

entities.title: Review exact bounded results
entities.definition: Receive exact large EventCards under the result heading, perform a real scroll and open a matching event or reach a terminal no-result state.

confidence.basis: Accepted browser, Android and iOS health cells.

unresolved_conflicts: The accepted health query returned five cards but is not a quality benchmark for all intents.

entities.title: Confirm whether Search matched the intent
entities.definition: After exact results are exhausted or a terminal state is reached, answer `matched` or `missed` before optional alternative recommendations.

confidence.basis: Explicit owner and USR-14 requirement; runtime outcome coverage is incomplete.

unresolved_conflicts: A positive answer may enter a separate review pipeline; that promotion pipeline is not treated as completed outcome evidence.

entities.title: Evaluate an event on its detail page
entities.definition: The user moves from an opened event identity through media, facts, occurrence, venue, transport and continuation context to a decision or next action.

confidence.basis: Event-detail contract and acceptance matrix.

unresolved_conflicts: Corrected UI SoT retains unresolved visual states and the public root remains NO-GO.

entities.title: Confirm event identity and lifecycle
entities.definition: See coherent title, occurrence, status and canonical identity before acting.

confidence.basis: Critical-fact and lifecycle scenarios.

unresolved_conflicts: A recent lifecycle incident proves identity/date coherence requires continuing runtime evidence.

entities.title: Inspect event media and summary
entities.definition: Use the admitted hero/gallery/poster representation and summary without image distortion, inappropriate letterboxing or loss of protected content.

confidence.basis: Media framing decision and acceptance scenarios.

unresolved_conflicts: Not all Event Detail media states are yet materialization-eligible in corrected UI SoT.

entities.title: Inspect occurrence, admission, venue and transport facts
entities.definition: Review exact dates/times, admission, named venue, participants and transport/route context needed for a practical decision.

confidence.basis: Event-detail anatomy and critical fact scenarios.

unresolved_conflicts: Third-party schedule and admission freshness vary by source and are guarded by last-good/absence policies.

entities.title: Choose attend, save, defer, reject or continue
entities.definition: Complete evaluation by taking an intent action, saving for later, dismissing, continuing to related events or leaving without a false completion claim.

confidence.basis: Actions and continuation exist; decision confidence is inferred only cautiously.

unresolved_conflicts: No action is not automatically a negative outcome; qualitative or explicit feedback is needed.

entities.title: Complete an event intent action
entities.definition: From a card or detail page, attempt save, calendar, share, ticket, registration, route or transport and receive authoritative success or an honest recovery state.

confidence.basis: Acceptance and strong-action analytics contract.

unresolved_conflicts: External actions differ in their authoritative terminal evidence.

entities.title: Choose an action for the exact event occurrence
entities.definition: Activate a visible, correctly named action bound to the current event and selected occurrence.

confidence.basis: CTA and occurrence acceptance scenarios.

entities.title: Perform an idempotent command or external handoff
entities.definition: Use the authoritative product command for internal state or the exact canonical destination for an external action without duplicating the attempt.

confidence.basis: Strong fact and idempotency contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: External handoffs may only prove navigation attempt unless a trusted callback exists.

entities.title: Receive authoritative success or recoverable failure
entities.definition: The interface reflects confirmed state, pending state or typed failure and never labels an unconfirmed attempt as completed.

confidence.basis: No-false-success invariant.

unresolved_conflicts: Terminal outcome semantics are capability-specific and cannot be represented by one generic click event.

entities.title: Return to saved events
entities.definition: Open Favorites, reconcile local/account state, review current lifecycle and continue or remove a uniquely saved event.

confidence.basis: Detailed acceptance inventory with incomplete end-to-end production evidence.

unresolved_conflicts: Anonymous/local, authenticated/cloud and reconciliation states are not uniformly proven.

entities.title: Open Favorites in the current identity context
entities.definition: Open `/izbrannoe/` and see an explicit local, account, loading, empty, populated or error state.

confidence.basis: UI and acceptance contracts exist.

unresolved_conflicts: Some Favorites states remain reconstructed UI contracts rather than accepted runtime evidence.

entities.title: Reconcile saved identity and lifecycle state
entities.definition: Deduplicate event identity, prevent account leakage and resolve current, moved, cancelled or ended state before display.

confidence.basis: Acceptance requirements are explicit; full implementation evidence is incomplete.

unresolved_conflicts: Cross-device revision lag and anonymous-to-account merge need explicit runtime evidence.

entities.title: Continue planning or remove the saved event
entities.definition: Open the current event, use an intent action, remove it idempotently or undo without creating duplicate state.

confidence.basis: Acceptance scenarios define the result.

entities.title: Use a personal or contextual event feed
entities.definition: Enter `/dlya-menya/`, resolve consent/profile maturity, receive static/contextual/personalized results, provide explicit signals and retain safe fallback and diversity.

confidence.basis: Target contracts and route exist; accepted outcome uplift does not.

unresolved_conflicts: Static, contextual and personalized modes must not be collapsed into one success state.

entities.title: Resolve consent, identity and profile maturity
entities.definition: Determine inactive, cold-start, contextual or active personal mode without making base discovery depend on authorization or analytics consent.

confidence.basis: Explicit activation and consent boundaries.

unresolved_conflicts: Exact production mode coverage is not represented by one accepted runtime receipt.

entities.title: Review bounded relevant and exploratory cards
entities.definition: Scan a non-empty compatible feed that surfaces relevance earlier while retaining diversity and explicit presentation mode.

confidence.basis: Target and acceptance contracts; outcome uplift missing.

unresolved_conflicts: No accepted randomized comparison proves incremental value versus static fallback.

entities.title: Open, save, hide or undo with explicit semantics
entities.definition: Use strong semantic actions that update authoritative state according to signal policy; diagnostic action-map data never mutates the profile.

confidence.basis: Personalization and action-map boundaries are explicit.

unresolved_conflicts: Signal-policy promotion requires separate benchmark and experiment evidence.

entities.title: Recover from typed discovery and action failures
entities.definition: A cross-cutting journey that preserves usable static content, explains the typed failure, retains last-good state where safe and offers retry or an alternative route.

confidence.basis: Recovery, loss and degradation contracts across product surfaces.

unresolved_conflicts: The full route × context recovery matrix is not yet complete.

entities.title: Identify a typed failure without erasing last-good state
entities.definition: Distinguish no result, unavailable service, stale state, rejected command, expired session, missing media and release failure rather than returning a generic success or empty surface.

confidence.basis: Typed Search, release, incident and analytics contracts.

entities.title: Preserve the static core and safe last-good content
entities.definition: Keep navigation, current static facts and safe last-good projections usable while optional runtime or publication paths fail closed.

confidence.basis: Static core and release rollback invariants.

unresolved_conflicts: Public root atomic promotion remains blocked, so some last-good guarantees are proven only in candidate infrastructure.

entities.title: Offer retry, alternate discovery or explicit stop
entities.definition: Provide a bounded next action appropriate to the failure: retry, use static listings, adjust intent, re-authenticate, restore saved state, remove stale state or wait for a checked release.

confidence.basis: Acceptance recovery examples.

unresolved_conflicts: Recovery success semantics differ by capability and require separate denominators.

entities.title: Participate in structured product feedback
entities.definition: An invited participant enters the focus-group surface, resolves eligibility, reviews a page or service state, submits bounded feedback and receives a durable acknowledgement.

confidence.basis: Focus-group routes and feedback contracts exist; full production membership/persistence is not uniformly proven.

unresolved_conflicts: Prototype and production feedback modes must remain distinct; a focus participant is not a general partner lane.

entities.title: Search returns no exact results
entities.definition: Show an explicit no-result message, collect match feedback at the correct terminal point and offer a separate alternative feed without representing it as exact Search results.

confidence.basis: USR-14 and Search contract.

entities.title: Search runtime, transport or quota failure
entities.definition: Keep the static listing usable, show a typed Search failure, prevent duplicate requests and offer safe retry or alternate discovery.

confidence.basis: Search transport and failure acceptance.

unresolved_conflicts: Accepted health shows the normal path; typed failure drills remain a separate evidence set.

entities.title: Identity or session unavailable
entities.definition: Explain the identity requirement for the gated capability, preserve base public discovery and allow safe retry without losing unrelated local state.

confidence.basis: Identity and consent acceptance scenarios.

unresolved_conflicts: Identity UI is not yet uniformly normalized across all page archetypes.

entities.title: Saved state is stale, moved, cancelled or conflicting
entities.definition: Reconcile against current event identity and lifecycle, show the truthful state and allow update/removal without duplicate or cross-account leakage.

confidence.basis: Acceptance contract exists; full runtime proof is incomplete.

unresolved_conflicts: Multi-device and account-switch recovery evidence remains incomplete.

entities.title: Media or optional event context is missing
entities.definition: Render a truthful typed fallback without layout collapse, false media metadata or loss of the core event link and facts.

confidence.basis: Typed no-image and broken-media acceptance.

unresolved_conflicts: Some mobile no-image states remain unresolved in corrected UI SoT.

entities.title: Optional dynamic surface is unavailable
entities.definition: Retain static catalog, navigation and event detail while Search, personalization, analytics, media or another optional runtime dependency is unavailable.

confidence.basis: Static core and degradation contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Exact degradation behavior differs by route and requires route-specific acceptance links.

entities.title: Reject a failed candidate and retain last-good release
entities.definition: A failed build, check, publication or stable smoke never advances the current pointer; operators retain or restore the last complete checked tree.

confidence.basis: Immutable candidate and atomic promotion contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Live ALB/SWS/DNS apply and rollback remain blocked; candidate isolation is stronger than root promotion evidence.
